h1: Sitthinard Grandview Hotel Phatthalung — a new downtown hotel with spacious rooms near Khao Ok Thalu
intro: If you want a newly built hotel with spacious, clean rooms right in the centre of Phatthalung, Sitthinard Grandview Hotel is one many travellers talk about. It's a 3-star hotel on Pisetkit Road in the Khuha Sawan area downtown, near Khao Ok Thalu and the Phatthalung clock tower. The air-conditioned rooms are spacious with big beds, balconies and city views, and there's a fitness room, free parking and a 7-Eleven inside the building. The overall score is 9.0 from real guest reviews (Trip.com), from around THB 900/night.

body.html: Sitthinard Grandview Hotel is a newly built hotel in the Khuha Sawan area in the centre of Phatthalung. The thing reviews mention most is how new and spacious the rooms are — many guests say everything still looks brand new, the rooms are bigger than expected and the beds are large and comfortable. The location is downtown, within walking distance of shops, restaurants and a hypermarket, and there's even a 7-Eleven right inside the building, which is very handy for self-drive travellers or anyone in town for business.

The rooms are air-conditioned with a private balcony and city views, plus a fridge, minibar, electric kettle, safe, flat-screen TV and a bathroom with a shower. Choices range from a Deluxe Twin (two single beds) and Deluxe King to a Family Deluxe and a Deluxe Suite. Some rooms are connecting rooms, which suit families or larger groups. This is a hotel that leans on new, spacious rooms and a downtown location rather than a resort feel with nature views.

"The hotel looks very new and everything is still in top condition. The rooms are spacious with a huge, comfortable bed, the staff are friendly and speak English, and having a 7-Eleven in the building is so convenient."

The most frequent praise goes to its cleanliness, spacious rooms and friendly service. Reviews say staff are kind, helpful and many speak English, which puts international guests at ease. Cleanliness and location both score around 9.2, with service around 8.8. There's a fitness room, a 24-hour reception, plenty of free private parking and free Wi-Fi. It suits solo travellers, couples and families who want a new room downtown at an accessible price.

To be honest, soundproofing between rooms isn't great. One family review notes their child's laughter carried to the neighbouring room, which felt awkward, and a few reviews mention the shower pressure being on the weak side. If you're a light sleeper or want quiet, ask for a corner room or one not next to a family room. The hotel also focuses on its city location and doesn't have a pool to use during many guests' stays, so if you plan to swim, check with the hotel before booking.

Location is one of this hotel's strengths. It's near Khao Ok Thalu, Phatthalung's landmark mountain, about 1–2 km away. It's a few hundred metres' walk to temples in the Khuha Sawan area such as Wat Phupha Pimuk and to the Phatthalung clock tower. It's close to the railway station and the town market, handy for both rail travellers and self-drivers. If you want to head to Thale Noi or Pak Pra, it works well as a base to drive out from.

In short, Sitthinard Grandview Hotel is best for travellers who want a new, spacious, clean room in a downtown Phatthalung location at a good price. If quiet sleep matters most to you, or you want a pool and lakeside nature views, this may not be the answer — look at a resort around Lampam Beach or Pak Pra instead. But if your goal is a crisp new room, easy access, and being near Khao Ok Thalu and the town's food, this fits the bill at a wallet-friendly rate.

A tip from following the reviews: if you're a family or a larger group, ask about a connecting room or the Family Deluxe — it's better value and more convenient. If you sleep lightly, request a room not next to a family room, since sound carries easily. And remember there's a 7-Eleven in the building, so a late-night snack run is just a few steps away.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Sitthinard Grandview Hotel Phatthalung

faq.q: Where is Sitthinard Grandview Hotel in Phatthalung, and what's nearby?
faq.a: It's at 69 Pisetkit Road, Khuha Sawan, Mueang Phatthalung, in the town centre — a few hundred metres' walk to Wat Phupha Pimuk and the Phatthalung clock tower. Khao Ok Thalu is about 1.2 km away, and the railway station is around 7 minutes by car. It makes an easy base for driving out to Thale Noi or Pak Pra.

faq.q: How much does Sitthinard Grandview Hotel cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rates start from around THB 900/night for a Deluxe Twin or Deluxe King. There's also a Family Deluxe (~฿1,300) and an extra-spacious Deluxe Suite (~฿1,500), and some rooms are connecting rooms. Prices vary by season, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does Sitthinard Grandview Hotel have a pool, and what's in the rooms?
faq.a: The hotel has no pool to use during many guests' stays, but there's a fitness room, a 24-hour reception, free parking and a 7-Eleven in the building. Every room is air-conditioned with a balcony and city view, plus a fridge, minibar, flat-screen TV and a safe.

faq.q: Who is Sitthinard Grandview Hotel best for?
faq.a: It's ideal for travellers who want a new, spacious, clean room in a downtown Phatthalung location — couples, families, or anyone in town on business who's driving around. If you want real quiet at night, a pool, or lakeside nature views, choose a resort around Lampam Beach or Pak Pra instead.

faq.q: Anything to know before booking Sitthinard Grandview Hotel?
faq.a: Soundproofing between rooms isn't great — some reviews note hearing the next room, and the shower pressure is a little weak. If you sleep lightly, ask for a corner room or one not next to a family room. Overall it's still great value for a new, spacious room downtown at this price.
